meta.subject: fix: write duplicate data to mxrequantizer

en.summary: Fixes a duplicated-write bug by correctly coupling the accumulator-scale output handshake with the mx requantizer input handshake.
why_it_counts: The patch changes Decoupled handshake logic in the AccumulatorScale datapath.
It fixes duplicated data delivery to downstream DUT logic, not infrastructure.
The changed signals directly control whether one source item is consumed once or replayed across two sinks.
evidence: AccumulatorScale.scala changes in.valid to require io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.ready.
io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.valid now depends on both io.in.valid and in.ready instead of mirroring io.in.valid unconditionally.
io.in.ready now requires both in.ready and io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.ready.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When one producer fans out a result to two consumers that must observe the same item in lockstep, the source may only fire when both consumers are able to accept that item. If one side can advance independently, one sink may see duplicated or misaligned data because the producer and the two downstream paths lose synchronization.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: two-sink handshake coupling on a shared producer
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A producer sends the same datapath item to a normal pipeline sink and a sideband or companion sink, and one of those sinks can stall independently.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the coupling between the two ready/valid handshakes so the producer can advance when only one sink is ready.
portability_notes: Apply this to designs that duplicate one source item into two synchronized channels.
The bug is about handshake coupling, not about the payload value itself.
The failure often appears as duplicate writes, repeated sideband data, or mismatched pairing between the two channels.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the source stage that drives both the main pipeline input and the companion sink.
Make the source valid and ready depend only on the main sink, or only on the companion sink, instead of both.
Leave the payload path unchanged so the observable failure is caused by unsynchronized consumption.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AccumulatorScale fanout from io.in to internal pipeline input and io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix makes the internal in channel and the mx_data_in channel advance only when both sides are ready, preventing duplicate writes to the mx requantizer.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Restore the older handshake pattern where io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.valid mirrors io.in.valid and io.in.ready ignores io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.ready.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: The companion sink can observe duplicate or replayed data, causing repeated writes or desynchronized data delivery into the requantizer path.
evidence_for_injection: All functional changes are on valid/ready equations at the fanout point.
The commit subject explicitly describes duplicate data written to mxrequantizer.
No arithmetic or format conversion logic changes in this commit.
notes: This bug is best exercised with backpressure on the mx requantizer input while the main path remains available.
A reverse patch is small and localized.

zh.summary: 该提交通过正确耦合 accumulator-scale 输出握手与 mx requantizer 输入握手，修复了重复写入问题。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 AccumulatorScale 数据通路中的 Decoupled 握手逻辑。
它修复的是向下游 DUT 逻辑重复发送数据的问题，而不是基础设施问题。
被修改的信号直接决定一个源数据项是被消费一次还是在两个接收端之间发生重放。
evidence: AccumulatorScale.scala 现在要求 io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.ready 才能拉高 in.valid。
io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.valid 不再无条件镜像 io.in.valid，而是同时依赖 io.in.valid 和 in.ready。
io.in.ready 现在同时要求 in.ready 和 io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.ready。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当一个生产者把同一个结果扇出到两个必须锁步观察同一数据项的消费者时，只有在两个消费者都能接收该数据项时，源端才能真正 fire。如果其中一侧可以独立前进，那么由于生产者和两个下游路径失去同步，其中一个接收端就可能看到重复或错位的数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 共享生产者上的双接收端握手耦合
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一个生产者把同一份数据同时送往主流水线接收端和旁路/伴随接收端，并且其中一个接收端可能独立阻塞。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 去掉两个 ready/valid 握手之间的耦合，使生产者在只有一侧 ready 时也能继续前进。
portability_notes: 适用于把同一源数据项复制到两个同步通道的设计。
该缺陷的核心是握手耦合错误，而不是负载数值本身。
失效通常表现为重复写入、旁路数据重放，或两个通道之间的配对失步。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到同时驱动主流水线输入和伴随接收端的源级逻辑。
让源端的 valid 和 ready 只依赖主接收端，或只依赖伴随接收端，而不是同时依赖两者。
保持负载路径不变，使可观察故障只来自不同步的消费行为。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: AccumulatorScale 中从 io.in 扇出到内部流水线输入和 io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in 的逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复让内部 in 通道和 mx_data_in 通道只有在两侧都 ready 时才一起前进，从而避免向 mx requantizer 重复写入数据。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 恢复旧的握手形式，让 io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.valid 直接镜像 io.in.valid，且 io.in.ready 不再依赖 io.mx_req_io.mx_data_in.ready。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 伴随接收端会看到重复或重放的数据，导致 requantizer 路径发生重复写入或数据交付失步。
evidence_for_injection: 所有功能性改动都集中在扇出点的 valid/ready 方程上。
提交标题明确描述了 duplicate data written to mxrequantizer。
该提交没有修改算术或格式转换逻辑。
notes: 最容易通过让 mx requantizer 输入产生反压、而主路径保持可接收来触发该缺陷。
逆向补丁很小且定位明确。
